content.comment_body: Hello, I have a question regarding a program I developed to achieve precise speed control by alternating between two frequencies. I've managed to switch frequencies to reach a target speed, but I also want to maintain that speed by lowering the frequency by 1 Hz when the sensed speed is reached, and increasing it again if the speed drops by a few revolutions per minute.
I believe I've found a solution by modifying the program logic along the control cycle I designed.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is working on a feedback-based speed control system that requires precise frequency adjustments based on sensor readings. The core challenge is to finely tune frequency in response to slight changes in speed detected by the sensor and to programmatically manage transitions around speed thresholds. The user has made progress iteratively, indicating the programming environment allows flexible logic adaptation.
analysis.user_expectations: The user seeks to precisely adjust speed by dynamically controlling frequency according to real-time sensor feedback, aiming to consistently maintain target speed levels.
